briefing: President Trump called his Asia trip a success despite few concrete results, and a second judge moved to block his planned arch. The White House fired its national cyber director after tech outages. The S&P 500 fell 3.7% in an AI stock sell-off, entering a correction. An Anthropic mathematician claimed a Riemann hypothesis proof, still unverified. In Idaho, lawmakers plan a bill to regulate e-motos.

sections.name: World and US
sections.brief: Trump's Asia trip yields few results; cyber director fired; arch blocked.

articles.headline: Trump calls Asia trip a success, with few concrete results
articles.summary: He announced joint AI guardrails with Xi but gave no details.

articles.headline: White House removes national cyber director after tech outages
articles.summary: Sean Cairncross is out; Pentagon IT chief Kirsten Davies is named his successor.

articles.headline: Second judge blocks Trump's planned arch in Virginia
articles.summary: Judge Brinkema will issue an injunction; the Justice Department will appeal.

articles.headline: Indian man sentenced to 19 years in plot to kill Sikh leader
articles.summary: Nikhil Gupta got 235 months in the murder-for-hire plot targeting Gurpatwant Singh Pannun.

articles.headline: Denmark accuses Russia of plot to kill Ukrainian-American rapper
articles.summary: Copenhagen will expel Russia's defence attache over a foiled September attack.

sections.name: Tech and AI
sections.brief: Trump threatens overseas data center ban; Anthropic Riemann claim; FCC vs California.

articles.headline: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centers abroad
articles.summary: He floated a "tremendous tax" with few details; enforcement is unclear.

articles.headline: Anthropic mathematician claims Claude proved the Riemann hypothesis
articles.summary: The claim is unverified; Terence Tao says checking it will take time.

articles.headline: FCC tells California to stop enforcing phone rules against AT&T
articles.summary: The order lets AT&T end copper phone service for about 199,000 customers.

articles.headline: Google redesigns search homepage around AI, drops search button
articles.summary: New buttons for image generation, file analysis and Gemini replace it.

articles.headline: Meta reconsiders 2030 net-zero goal as AI data center emissions jump
articles.summary: Its 2026 report cites AI demand; emissions rose from 15.6 to 21.7 million tonnes.

sections.name: Business and Healthcare
sections.brief: S&P 500 drops 3.7% in AI sell-off; Democrats probe rural health fund delay.

articles.headline: S&P 500 falls 3.7% as AI stocks sell off, entering a correction
articles.summary: Worst week in over 18 months; the Nasdaq is now negative for the year.

articles.headline: Democrats press Oz over delayed $50B rural health awards
articles.summary: 18 lawmakers want answers on a nine-day delay and cuts in some states.

articles.headline: FDA rejects Capricor's cell therapy for Duchenne
articles.summary: Two trials failed to show deramiocel protected the heart or muscle function.

articles.headline: HHS picks 15 groups to test food-as-medicine in Medicare
articles.summary: The MAHA ELEVATE pilot will test whether lifestyle programs cut costs.

articles.headline: Democrats set to widen probe of Obamacare coverage cancellations
articles.summary: A Senate inquiry into 760,000 cancellations gains weight with Democratic control.

sections.name: Idaho
sections.brief: E-moto bill planned; Medicaid work rule delay undecided; legislator pay frozen.

articles.headline: Idaho lawmakers plan bill to classify e-motos as motorcycles
articles.summary: Riders would need a motorcycle endorsement under the proposal.

articles.headline: Idaho undecided on delaying Medicaid work requirements
articles.summary: Federal regulators moved the deadline from Jan. 1 to June 30.

articles.headline: Idaho legislator pay frozen for a year, then set to rise
articles.summary: A citizens committee voted 5-1 to hold pay at $25,000 until Dec. 2027.

articles.headline: Idaho providers weigh first year of federal rural health grant
articles.summary: Small clinics say they got no answers on denied applications.

articles.headline: Bird flu returns to dairy herds, including Idaho's
articles.summary: Officials urge USDA to speed a cattle vaccine framework.
